note: These phases are an interface sequence for source-traced geometry. They do not invent clock times. The source drawing is an operation overview, so the final 1949-10-27 phase intentionally has no source-traced geometry until separately reviewed.

summary.zh-Hant: 歷史圖面顯示北岸登陸方向與灘岸附近的多條藍、紅色行動線；不表示船隻航跡。
summary.en: The source drawing shows northern coastal landing directions and several blue/red action graphics; it is not a vessel track.

summary.zh-Hant: 圖面中的分支箭頭與寬帶形狀表示行動方向與範圍，不等同道路或單一部隊路徑。
summary.en: Branches and broad bands in the drawing indicate direction and area, not roads or a single unit track.

summary.zh-Hant: 藍色路徑與紅色箭頭在圖面上交會；其歷史關係可展示，精確時間與道路追蹤仍未建立。
summary.en: Blue paths and red arrows meet in the drawing; the historical relationship is displayable, but exact timing and road-following tracks are not established.

summary.zh-Hant: 圖面保留多條分支與封鎖／防線符號；不把它們合併成一條直線。
summary.en: The source preserves branches and blocking/defensive symbols; they are not collapsed into one straight line.

summary.zh-Hant: 以圖面所示北端方向與防線關係作為相對階段展示；沒有補入未標示的鐘點。
summary.en: The relative northern direction and defensive relationship in the source are shown as a phase; no unmarked clock time is added.

summary.zh-Hant: 這張來源圖是戰役經過總覽，未提供可獨立確認的 10/27 專屬路線；本階段維持誠實空白。
summary.en: The source is an operation overview and does not provide independently confirmable 10/27-specific routes; this phase remains honestly empty.
